Path: fleet decision — the documented local dev door starts | 缺项 (`apps/console` dev server) | none

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:devx` · `area:devpath` · `pm:queue`

Triage: lands in `apps/console/vite.config.ts` (`OPTIMIZE_DEPS_INCLUDE`, the bare `'react-map-gl'` at :676) ⇒ `domain:devx`, the engineering surface. Rationale: the dev server exits at start, because the installed `react-map-gl` 8.1.2 exports no `.`. That breaks AGENTS.md's 「Local dev」 and the `verify` skill's preview gallery, the path every seat uses to check UI work. `Build & E2E` stays green because `vite build` never reads `optimizeDeps.include`, so no CI check sees it ⇒ **p2**.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-28T01:19Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card (no comments).

**Execution notes.**
1. Drop the bare `'react-map-gl'` entry; `'react-map-gl/maplibre'` is the subpath the tree imports. Judge the `maplibre-gl` resolve warning in the same change.
2. Pin it by extending an existing check (the no-new-gate default): every `OPTIMIZE_DEPS_INCLUDE` specifier resolves under the dev conditions. A deliberately bad specifier must go red.
